desc: The infrared early-warning constellation that the board's fastwalker material comes off, and which the board did not carry. GAO describes DSP as a strategic surveillance and warning satellite system with an infrared capability to detect ballistic missile launches, feeding the integrated tactical warning and attack assessment mission, begun in 1967 with the first operational satellite in 1971 and now being replaced by SBIRS-High. Its place here is documentary rather than anomalous: the board already carries the AFIT thesis that defines 'fastwalker' as ordinary space-surveillance vocabulary and cites a 1972-onward observation database drawn from ballistic missile early warning satellites in geosynchronous orbit, which is this constellation. What the popular literature adds, that DSP is the system that sees UFOs, is not stated by any government document opened for this node; that equation is The Black Vault's own gloss. What the record does carry is a refusal: USNORTHCOM found two responsive documents on the fastwalker and slowwalker designations in 2013, withheld both, and declined to search NORAD's holdings at all on the ground that NORAD is a bi-national organisation outside FOIA.

dossier.narrative: The node exists to keep a claim and its evidence in the same place. On the documented side, GAO gives the system, its dates and its replacement history, and a named command has confirmed holding responsive records on the fastwalker designation and withheld all of them, which is a fact about custody rather than about content. On the alleged side, the board already carries the AFIT thesis that defines fastwalker as ordinary space-surveillance vocabulary and cites a 1972-onward observation database drawn from ballistic missile early warning satellites in geosynchronous orbit. The Danny Jones corpus adds the human link and then undercuts it: Bob Fish, writing to John Podesta on 6 March 2015, says that one of the government programs that collects hard data on unidentified flying objects is the USAF DSP satellite program, and in the same email says he was never fully briefed into the DSP operation directly, dates his exposure to the run-up to Desert Shield and Desert Storm rather than to the 1980s, and relays the detection he describes as a remark made to him at lunch. No speed figure appears in any of the three emails opened. The equation of DSP with UFO tracking is a claim with a named author and a documented qualification, and both belong on the board.

dossier.whatItIs: The United States Air Force infrared early-warning satellite constellation, described by GAO as a strategic surveillance and warning satellite system with an infrared capability to detect ballistic missile launches, begun in 1967 with the first operational satellite in 1971 and replaced by SBIRS-High.
dossier.whyImplicated: It is the constellation the popular fastwalker literature equates with UFO detection. The board carries it in order to hold that equation to the documents: no government record opened for this node states it, and the private correspondent most often cited for it says in the same breath that he was never fully briefed into the programme.
